files.description: A Slack thread in #refunds-desk between Skyway staff about pets in the cabin, dated between 2026-01-12 and 2026-05-15: a normal working conversation; one message may carry each sentence below. It must contain these sentences word for word: "the pet fee goes back if the pet did not fly"; "any fare, Basic included". Do not state any other policy amount, limit, deadline or rule. Any example situation must fit these sentences: do not show anyone giving, arranging or refusing a hotel, meal, voucher, credit, refund or compensation beyond what they say, and do not set an example in a weather, air traffic control or airport security disruption unless they mention it. Do not end the thread with a summary of the answer. Do not mention battery, batteries, lithium, power bank, watt-hour.
